body:
Hi, I'm the podcast host that originally reported this issue.

Here's a link to our [feed](https://techjr.dev/rss.xml) (We're currently working on listing items latest-first)

We generate our RSS through markdown files that eventually get parsed through this [RSS npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/rss).

We haven't had issues with any other podcast platforms that consume our feed. [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/4jFt5Yjfs1jmimj52S2Wve), [google](https://playmusic.app.goo.gl/?ibi=com.google.PlayMusic&isi=691797987&ius=googleplaymusic&apn=com.google.android.music&link=https://play.google.com/music/m/Iqm76lldc555i6v2taar7d4fd3a?t%3DTech_Jr%26pcampaignid%3DMKT-na-all-co-pr-mu-pod-16), and [iTunes](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/tech-jr/id1465115096) all list new episodes from our feed.

However on dev.to, no additional episodes beyond episode 6 were being listed. After speaking with @michael-tharrington, we determined that because my feed listed items out of order, Dev's algorithm for checking feeds was not detecting new episodes.

Internally in our build process, there was no sorting mechanism in place for ordering the items in the RSS feed, despite other popular RSS providers like libsyn sorting items chronologically. I've made some PRs to the npm package we use to generate our feed to correctly sort based on date.

However, I have not been able to find any spec or standard for RSS that states feed items must be chronological or latest-first. I assume that the major aggregators check the feeds for `pubDate` and `guid` tags to determine if there are new items present.

## Description
Added logic to the `Podcasts::Feed` class that checks whether the RSS is ordered newest to oldest or oldest to newest. Depending on the way it's ordered we'll check the first or last five elements of the RSS feed. 

## Related Tickets & Documents
resolves issue #3580
